transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I need help dealing with the people who are constantly monitoring me. They have tapped my phone and are tracking my every move, and I need someone to help me make them stop.
That sounds incredibly stressful and exhausting to go through. While we work on understanding these experiences, how has this been affecting your sleep and overall mood lately?

It has been really hard to get any decent sleep lately because I'm constantly on edge and worried about what they are doing. My mood has been very tense and exhausted from dealing with this every single day. I just feel overwhelmed by the constant stress of it all.
Aside from feeling tense and overwhelmed, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or seen things that others didn't see?

No, I have never heard any voices or seen things that weren't there. My eyes and ears work perfectly fine, and everything I'm experiencing is happening in the real world. I just see and hear the same things anyone else would, but I'm just more aware of what they are doing to me.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting a week or more where you felt extremely energetic, hyperactive, or needed very little sleep, separate from the stress of these experiences?

No, I've never had periods like that where I felt unusually energetic or didn't need to sleep. My sleep issues are purely because I'm anxious about being watched, not because I have extra energy. I generally just feel very tired and drained from all of this.
Aside from the exhaustion from these experiences, have you ever had a period of two weeks or more where you felt consistently down, sad, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?

No, I haven't really experienced persistent sadness or a loss of interest like that for two weeks or more. Any down days I have are just because I'm so tired of being monitored all the time, not from depression.
Apart from the stress of this monitoring, how have you been managing with your daily responsibilities, like work, self-care, or chores?

Honestly, I manage my daily responsibilities, work, and self-care quite well. My functioning is completely normal and I get my tasks done, except for the fact that I'm constantly distracted and stressed by the monitoring.
How long has this monitoring and tracking of your phone and movements been going on?

This monitoring and tracking has been going on constantly for about eight months now. It is incredibly frustrating and exhausting that it has lasted this long without any relief. I just want it to finally stop so I can have my peace of mind back.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were Delusional Disorder and Schizophrenia. Based on the patient's report, they have experienced persecutory beliefs for 8 months without any hallucinations, disorganized speech, disorganized behavior, or negative symptoms, and their daily functioning and self-care remain completely normal apart from the distraction of the monitoring. This absence of functional decline and lack of other primary psychotic symptoms makes Schizophrenia highly unlikely, pointing strongly to Delusional Disorder. Since sufficient evidence has been gathered, I am finalizing the diagnosis.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with non-bizarre persecutory delusions (being monitored and tracked) lasting for approximately eight months. Hallucinations are absent, and there are no prominent mood episodes (manic or depressive) or significant negative symptoms. Aside from the direct impact of the delusions, the patient's daily functioning and behavior are relatively preserved, which strongly supports a diagnosis of Delusional Disorder.
